sourceRefs.locator: “The birthplace of Christianity in Scotland” and “Columba’s monastery”. Foundation tradition of 563, timber-building evidence, the later church and the eighth- and ninth-century crosses.
Source Description, Primary Manuscripts no. 1. Schaffhausen Stadtbibliothek, Generalia 1, colophon p. 136a, the two-column copy and the likely date before 713.
Origin and Provenance. Dorbbéne’s prayer on p. 136 and the partly erased Reichenau ex-libris at the foot of p. 1.
Designation LB12310, national grid NM 28683 24515; rounded to island-site scale.
